subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: The Double Rocker: Neither Spins Fully
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Double Rocker: Neither Spins Fully.

hook.text: Sometimes no link can rotate fully. Both grounded links just rock.

buildup.text: This happens when the fixed link isn't the shortest one in the chain.

discovery.text: Both rockers oscillate while the coupler floats between them.

twist.text: The coupler can still trace useful curves even when nothing rotates.

climax.text: Many suspension systems and aircraft flap mechanisms use double rockers.

punchline.text: No full spin, but plenty of useful motion.

quiz.question: What characterizes a double-rocker linkage?
options: Both grounded links oscillate and neither can make a full revolution
Both grounded links spin continuously in opposite directions
The coupler link is fixed while the frame rotates
